final: WITH race_names AS (SELECT r.name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS field_size FROM driverStandings AS ds JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) AS avg_field_size FROM race_names) SELECT AVG(rn.avg_points) AS avg_points, AVG(rn.field_size) AS avg_field_size, AVG(rn.field_size - o.avg_field_size) AS avg_field_size_above_overall FROM race_names AS rn CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE rn.field_size > o.avg_field_size
